data.name: Improved Armor
data.description: Your mind armor improves depending on its form.  Light form is treaded as if not wearing armor, while still gaining the armor bonus to Armor Class.  Medium form is treated as masterwork breastplate.  Heavy form is treated as masterwork full plate.
